data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 abstracts SRC_003's lookup-table analogy: both rely on the claim that different causal mechanisms produce different error signatures, but SRC_005 generalizes from the lookup-table/checklist domain to any frozen-theory-vs-mutable-theory comparison, using error-shape as the universal signature. It is refuted if error signatures are proven domain-specific and non-transferable across frozen-theory artifacts, so the shared structure does not support a generalization across lookup tables and checklists.
